description: Add, modify, or delete a password policy using the IPA API.

parameters.name: dictcheck
parameters.description: Check whether the password (with possible modifications) matches a word in a dictionary (using cracklib). Choices: false true

parameters.name: failinterval
parameters.description: Period (in seconds) after which the number of failed login attempts is reset.

parameters.name: gracelimit
parameters.description: Maximum number of LDAP logins after password expiration.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Name of the group that the policy applies to. If omitted, the global policy is used.

parameters.name: historylength
parameters.description: Number of previous passwords that are remembered. Users cannot reuse remembered passwords.

parameters.name: ipa_host
parameters.description: IP or hostname of IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_HOST is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_HOST and the value are not specified in the task, then DNS is used to try to discover the FreeIPA server. The relevant entry needed in FreeIPA is the ipa-ca entry. If neither the DNS entry, nor the environment IPA_HOST, nor the value are available in the task, then the default value is used. Default: "ipa.example.com"

parameters.name: ipa_pass
parameters.description: Password of administrative user. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PASS is used instead. Note that if the urllib_gssapi library is available, it is possible to use GSSAPI to authenticate to FreeIPA. If the environment variable KRB5CCNAME is available, the module uses this Kerberos credentials cache to authenticate to the FreeIPA server. If the environment variable KRB5_CLIENT_KTNAME is available, and KRB5CCNAME is not; the module uses this Kerberos keytab to authenticate. If GSSAPI is not available, the usage of ipa_pass is required.

parameters.name: ipa_port
parameters.description: Port of FreeIPA / IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PORT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PORT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 443

parameters.name: ipa_prot
parameters.description: Protocol used by IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PROT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PROT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: ipa_timeout
parameters.description: Specifies idle timeout (in seconds) for the connection. For bulk operations, you may want to increase this in order to avoid timeout from IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 10

parameters.name: ipa_user
parameters.description: Administrative account used on IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_USER is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_USER and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: "admin"

parameters.name: lockouttime
parameters.description: Period (in seconds) for which users are locked out.

parameters.name: maxfailcount
parameters.description: Maximum number of consecutive failures before lockout.

parameters.name: maxpwdlife
parameters.description: Maximum password lifetime (in days).

parameters.name: maxrepeat
parameters.description: Maximum number of allowed same consecutive characters in the new password.

parameters.name: maxsequence
parameters.description: Maximum length of monotonic character sequences in the new password. An example of a monotonic sequence of length 5 is 12345.

parameters.name: minclasses
parameters.description: Minimum number of character classes.

parameters.name: minlength
parameters.description: Minimum password length.

parameters.name: minpwdlife
parameters.description: Minimum password lifetime (in hours).

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Priority of the policy. High number means lower priority. Required when cn is not the global policy.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State to ensure. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: usercheck
parameters.description: Check whether the password (with possible modifications) contains the user name in some form (if the name has > 3 characters). Choices: false true

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: This only applies if ipa_prot is https. If set to false, the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to false used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Modify the global password policy
  community.general.ipa_pwpolicy:
    maxpwdlife: '90'
    minpwdlife: '1'
    historylength: '8'
    minclasses: '3'
    minlength: '16'
    maxfailcount: '6'
    failinterval: '60'
    lockouttime: '600'
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Ensure the password policy for the group admins is present
  community.general.ipa_pwpolicy:
    group: admins
    state: present
    maxpwdlife: '60'
    minpwdlife: '24'
    historylength: '16'
    minclasses: '4'
    priority: '10'
    minlength: '6'
    maxfailcount: '4'
    failinterval: '600'
    lockouttime: '1200'
    gracelimit: 3
    maxrepeat: 3
    maxsequence: 3
    dictcheck: true
    usercheck: true
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Ensure that the group sysops does not have a unique password policy
  community.general.ipa_pwpolicy:
    group: sysops
    state: absent
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

return_values.name: pwpolicy
return_values.description: Password policy as returned by IPA API. Returned: always Sample: {"cn": ["admins"], "cospriority": ["10"], "dn": "cn=admins,cn=EXAMPLE.COM,cn=kerberos,dc=example,dc=com", "krbmaxpwdlife": ["60"], "krbminpwdlife": ["24"], "krbpwdfailurecountinterval": ["600"], "krbpwdhistorylength": ["16"], "krbpwdlockoutduration": ["1200"], "krbpwdmaxfailure": ["4"], "krbpwdmindiffchars": ["4"], "objectclass": ["top", "nscontainer", "krbpwdpolicy"]}
